title: /debug
line: Make a bug fail on demand, then rerun the same check.

beats.caption: You describe the symptom at the command line.
The same input reliably gives the wrong result.
The parser excludes the flag from the name.

takeaway.title: Keep the failing command
takeaway.line: Rerun it after the fix to prove the symptom is gone.

title.text: When a bug has several plausible causes, start with one command that catches the symptom every time.

scene.text: With slash debug, Pi exercises the actual greeting command. It captures the bad output, checks how the name is chosen, and makes the flag separate from the positional argument.

takeaway.text: Then Pi runs the original check again. You can keep that same test as a regression check.
